subject: Read the whole Bible in 2027?
preview: A free plan starts January 1. Here is how to read it well.

blocks.text: Every January, a lot of us make the same promise.
This is the year I read the whole Bible.
And a few weeks later, the bookmark is stuck somewhere in the middle.
Most people think reading the Bible and studying the Bible are the same thing.
They are not.
You open a passage. Read a chapter. Close the book. Move on.
Finishing chapters feels like progress. But it does not always change much.
Here is what I want you to understand.
The goal is not to check a box. The goal is to understand what God is saying.
The Bible is not a random collection of verses. It is one connected story.
Joseph. Moses. David. Israel. Jesus. Paul. Each story stands on its own, and each one connects.
When you read it that way, the stories stick and the whole Bible starts to make sense.
Slow down. Ask questions. Seek context. Follow the story.
That is why I want to invite you to start the Bible in One Year inside Bible Buddy on January 1.
It walks you from Genesis to Revelation, one day at a time, over 365 days.
📖 A daily Bible reading
🎧 An audio lesson you can listen to
📝 Study notes that explain what you just read
🧠 Trivia to help it stick
You do not have to do it perfectly. You just have to start.
Before you open Day 1, read this short guide on how to read the Bible with understanding instead of just checking a box.
